name: Majestic Tours
brand_truth: A Bahamian family company that has met guests at the airport and taken them across the water since June 1959.
buyer: Resort guests on Paradise Island and Cable Beach, cruise passengers and arriving air travellers, deciding on a phone today or tomorrow; travel agents and groups.

direction.why: The business sells where the day goes from Nassau, so the page is a sideways voyage stop by stop; Bay Street pastel is Cumberland Street itself, a gracious 1959 Nassau family firm.

big_idea: The page is a boat leaving Nassau Harbour: scroll carries you sideways from the Flying Cloud sunset sail out to Blue Lagoon, Rose Island, the reefs, the Exuma Cays 38 nm out and Harbour Island, with the real trips at every stop, ending at the booking desk.
tier_why: A day out is explained by the journey and their own photographs; no 3D needed.
concept_type: brochure + enquiry: excursion catalogue with filters, transfers explainer, prefilled enquiry

revisions: stop rail on the phone first screen
frames varied, photos at source size, Blue Lagoon mostly photo
passage lines between stops (sourced times/distances only)

current_site_findings: The footer still says 2012-2021, and the homepage shows no phone number or email.
Every tour page sends guests to info@majestictourbahamas.com, which is missing an s: those emails probably never arrive.
Two pages list different hotel desks and different extensions.
37 excursions sit in one alphabetical list with no filters.
The 1959 founding and five industry awards are hidden on the About page.
pitch_line: You have taken Nassau guests out on the water since 1959, but your site still says 2021 and your tour emails go to a misspelled address; this concept sails a guest from the harbour to the Exumas in one scroll and books it in one message.
assumptions: Which hotel desks are current (two pages of the current site disagree)
Listed prices for the Flying Cloud Evening Dinner and the Exuma Day Trip are still current
Tour enquiries by email to transport@majesticholidays.com are accepted
Our tour groupings by place and kind of day
Passage lines for Blue Lagoon, Rose Island, reefs and Harbour Island are plain geography, not timed routes
